summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of LUMIÈRE demi-fine catalog (static, no backend). All 14 review checkpoints verified end-to-end using Playwright with window.open captured via init script. All flows PASS: page load with 16 cards & (16) count, category pill Rings filters to 4 correct ring SKUs and toggles back to All (16), all filter tabs return correct counts (Best 6, Under1499 13, New 5, Essentials 7, All 16), live desktop and mobile search work (pearl -> 3 items ER-07/NK-13/ST-16, zzzz -> catalog-empty), wishlist toggles heart aria-pressed=true and persists in localStorage.lumiere_wishlist, product modal opens with correct title/price/thumbnails and image swap on thumb click, metal selector updates modal-selected-metal to '18K Rose Gold', size 8 becomes aria-pressed, size-guide modal shows ring sizes incl. 51.8 mm and closes, Escape and modal-close-btn close modal, Add to Bag creates bag item 'LUM-RN-01__Rose Gold__8' with total ₹1,299, qty+/- correctly move total to ₹2,598 / ₹1,299, remove clears to bag-empty, quick-add-btn adds default metal without opening modal, bag persistence across reload works (localStorage.lumiere_bag), Buy Now WhatsApp URL starts https://wa.me/919112299902?text= and decoded text contains 'NEW ORDER INQUIRY', SKU LUM-RN-01, Rose Gold, Size 8; Checkout WhatsApp URL for 2 items contains 'SHOPPING BAG ORDER', 'Grand Total', both item names; mobile (390x844) bottom-nav visible with all 4 items and bag badge, product modal opens as bottom sheet (full width, y-offset ~68), search toggle reveals search-input; hero-explore-btn scrolls to catalog; footer WA & size-guide links work; desktop nav-catalog and nav-why scroll; no horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390 widths.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: header-bag-count testid also appears on hero mobile only when scrolled (single element in practice); strict Playwright queries need .first — no functional impact.

Note: The review request text mentions 'best sellers (7 items)' but the data file (products.js) actually has 6 best sellers (LUM-RN-01, LUM-PD-02, LUM-BR-04, LUM-NK-06, LUM-ER-11, LUM-ST-15) — this matches the enumerated SKU list in the same acceptance criterion. The tab shows (6) correctly. Consider updating either the data or the spec if 7 was intended.
Nice-to-have: `matchesTab` treats missing flags as falsy which is fine, but tag-based filtering could be added for 'Waterproof Essentials' if intent is broader than isEssential.
Search field uses `${p.name} ${p.category} ${p.material} ${p.tag}` — description is not searchable which is intentional; documented for future testers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: window.open is intercepted via page.add_init_script recording URLs into window.__waUrls; framer-motion popLayout exit animations require ~1200-1500ms wait before counting visible cards (use bounding rect + opacity filter, since exiting cards remain in DOM briefly). header-bag-count exists once in header only, but Playwright strict mode may see re-mounted spring nodes during animation — use .first(). No backend to test.
